name: Executor-class Star Dreadnought
description: The Executor-class Star Dreadnought, colloquially known as the Executor-class Super Star Destroyer, Executor-class Star Destroyer or simply Super Star Destroyer, was a heavy warship class in the Star Dreadnought league, often used as command ships and flagships in the Imperial Navy. At their prime, they were among the largest vessels in the galaxy, and were almost invincible in combat, although they were costly to operate.

data.name: Executor-class Star Dreadnought
manufacturer: Kuat Drive Yards (majority of the ship line)
Fondor Shipyards (Executor finishing touches; unidentified variant of the class that possessed cloaking capabilities)
armament: Turbolaser batteries (2,000, fire-linked in groups of 8)
Heavy turbolaser batteries (2,000, fire-linked in groups of 8)
Phylon Transport Q7 tractor beam projectors (40)
complement: TIE Series starfighters (144) (can reach up to 2,048 TIE Series starfighters if fully loaded )
Various other assault and support craft (total of 200)
